name: Sun Cleric Vow of the Eclipse: effective healing applies a 5% heal over time to the healed ally (#13312)
contract: Vow of the Eclipse 807435 reads 'Direct ability damage or effective healing ... burns for 5% of the damage
or healing done every 3 sec for 18 sec. Each trigger increases the damage of this effect. Additional
applications do not refresh the duration', its buff reads 'replicates its effect over time', and its
Fulfillment reads 'Direct ability damage or healing done by you is increased by 10% on targets affected by
Vow of the Eclipse'. Spell.dbc holds the friendly half: 807437 effect 0 points at 505370 (Vow of the
Eclipse, rank Heal) with 5, and 505370 is a SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_HEAL on TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY with
amplitude 3000 ms and DurationIndex 85 (18000 ms). The PR author ruled on #13312 that damage replicates as
the burn 505340 and healing as the heal 505370. The server sent 5% of a heal to the cleric's attack victim
as the burn, so with no victim nothing ticked and no ally could carry the Vow for Fulfillment. The cleric
attacks nothing here. A heal must put 505370 on the ally at 5% of its effective healing per tick, and a
second heal adds its 5% to the same single aura without refreshing the duration. Under Dawn 807440 a heal on
the marked ally adds 803816 for 10% (Dawn 807444 effect 1). Spell power 3000 keeps the heals large enough
that truncating each percentage to whole points stays below 0.1% of the ratio. Gift of C'Thun 706189 (effect
1 aura 136, +4% healing done) is on the cleric: the copy already holds the outgoing modifiers, so a tick
must heal for exactly its aura amount, not 4% more (the native tick-time multiplier exemption).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: Gift of C'Thun's +4% healing done is on the cleric
Take Vow of the Eclipse
SETUP: Vow of the Eclipse is active
Let the Vow's global cooldown expire
Leave room for the whole heal
Heal the ally with no attack victim
SETUP: the first heal lands
Let the Vow resolve
DISCRIMINATING: the healed ally carries the cleric's heal over time 505370
Each tick heals for 5% of the effective healing
It lasts 18 sec
It ticks every 3 sec
DISCRIMINATING: the tick heals its aura amount, healing done is not applied twice
Let the global cooldown expire
Heal the ally again mid-duration
SETUP: the second heal lands
Let the Vow resolve
Each trigger increases the effect: the tick is 5% of both heals
One aura, not a second stack
Additional applications do not refresh the duration
FIXTURE: Dawn requires 20 Solar Power
FIXTURE: Dawn's caster aura readiness marker
Let the global cooldown expire
Enter Dawn
SETUP: Dawn is active
Let the global cooldown expire
SETUP: the ally still carries the cleric's 505370
Heal the marked ally under Dawn
SETUP: the fulfilling heal lands
Let the Vow copy resolve
Fulfillment: healing on an ally affected by the Vow is increased by 10%
